selection-mark.value: Does the first option show a visible trailing check exactly when that option is selected in this published state, without changing its label?

body-wrap.value: Is every supplied context sentence visible with natural wrapping at the specified body size throughout this captured state?

content-overlap.value: Do the title, paragraphs, choices, summary, confirmation, status, receipt, and primary action remain clear of one another throughout the captured component?

horizontal-fit.value: Does all component content remain within the offered child width with no horizontal clipping?

type-hierarchy.value: Does the title use a clearly larger semibold system style than the normal body copy, matching the authored 24 and 15 native size intent?

context-label.value: Prepare a workspace capacity change from current seat demand, allocation limits, and prepaid credit. The component records a request and does not charge a payment method. Please read this caller-supplied narrative in full before recording the request. The facilities, people, and operations teams share this reusable panel, so the narrative may include several complete sentences and meaningful spaces. Every sentence must remain visible when the host scrolls; the panel must grow naturally instead of clipping, shrinking the type, or introducing an internal scroll region.
